artBrief: **Japanese paper fantasy.** An origami dragon unfolds from a stack of cards, with red maple leaves circling its wings. Clear dragon silhouette rather than intricate microtexture.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Japanese paper fantasy. An origami dragon unfolds from a stack of cards, with red maple leaves circling its wings. Clear dragon silhouette rather than intricate microtexture. A single bold crimson folded-paper dragon is the hero, with clearly folded wings and a stack of ivory cards beneath. Autumn gold and indigo setting.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
